stemMd: Which trial most directly tests a prediction unique to Investigator3 among these models?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Observe strong wind over the unchanged lake.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Warm clear water above the stated threshold without wind, loose sediment, or spring inflow

options.label: C
options.textMd: Measure the lake only on another windy daytime.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Stir a tank containing both loose sediment and spring inflow.

explanationMd: Investigator3 predicts cloudiness from threshold warming even without the causes proposed by the other two. Removing sediment, spring flow and stirring makes that distinctive prediction testable.

distractorRationale.c: This repeats a condition compatible with multiple explanations.
distractorRationale.d: Both Investigators1 and2 could explain resulting cloudiness.
